messages:
jess: quick sync note  we've been losing utilization to weird MIG fragmentation. proposal: small opt-in packing-contract API. runtime returns 2-4 concrete node templates plus a compact intent signature and a few tidy heuristics: frag_delta, warmup_s, eviction_penalty (ordinal + estimate). operator picks template.

devon: +1 to opt-in. operator should pass pending admission snapshot + backfill_deadline and a hard_constraint flag (e.g., must_allow_full_gpu=true).

marco: please include coalesce_hints referencing pending indexes (cheap knapsack hint like 1/4+1/4->1/2). keep response tiny; autoscaler will call this in the hot path.

liyah: include TTL and confidence (low|med|high) so operator applies hysteresis. also a stability_hint (minutes) to avoid flip-flopping.

jess: runtime impl note: avoid model loads. use cached perf profiles + seq-length histogram + recent pinned-job counts. cheap sim only.

devon: eviction_penalty should be a simple formula: ordinal (low/med/high) + est_evictions_per_hour. operator maps that to its cost ledger.

marco: telemetry: packing_contract_requests, template_chosen, frag_delta_post_launch (operator reports back), contract_rejects. add watchdog that auto-disables pack_contracts for pool if pinned-job p99 regresses >5% over 10m.

liyah: rollout: per-pool feature flag default off, canary pools with pack_opt_in=true. add kill-switch and automatic rollback on SLO regressions.

jess: testing plan: 1) offline sim with historical admission traces; 2) small canary pool honoring templates; 3) synthetic pinned-job spike to validate watchdog.

ops-bot: ticket INF-7120 created: "packing-contract API + autoscaler integration"

jess: action items: i'll draft RFC + example responses; marco: add sim job; liyah: add operator hook and rollout checklist; devon: sanity-check eviction_penalty heuristic. will post RFC in channel shortly :rocket:
